entries.a5fe1b8cac0f50ae: Its distinguishing feature is that, as a company that operates restaurants directly and also expands them under licensing, it can use the know-how gained at those sites to provide integrated support to other restaurants, covering store openings, closures, equipment, personnel and overseas expansion. By holding both the supporting side and the store-operating side of the business within its own group, it creates services tailored to the challenges of restaurant management.
entries.a7b570cd6405171a: Its management philosophy reads: “Together with people who aspire to grow and with organizations (companies) that aspire to transform (challenge), we will keep creating new value and keep growing.” Under its corporate slogan, “Turning dreams into reality! Bringing Japanese cuisine to the world!”, it aims to be a bridge spreading Japanese food culture from Japan to regions around the world. By linking its management support business and restaurant business, it has formed a unique “platform.” For the management support business, it states that its challenges are strengthening its sales structure centered on domestic store opening and closing support and developing foreign talent placement support into a core pillar of the business. For the restaurant business, it states that it will focus on improving earnings capacity at existing stores and will also consider brand conversion or sale of unprofitable stores and stores where growth has slowed.
